entries.mechanism: issue: https://github.com/PolicyEngine/policyengine-us/issues/9170. Under 26 USC 68(a)(2), the relevant base is taxable income determined without section 68, increased by the itemized deductions otherwise allowable. Here the completed lawful scalar is 550,000 and pre-section-68 itemized deductions are 50,000; after the separate 100,000 below-line deduction, 600,000 is below the 640,600 single threshold, so the lawful reduction is zero and Axiom returns 50,000. Pinned itemized_taxable_income_deductions_reduction.py instead forms taxable_income=max(0, adjusted_gross_income - exemptions). With AGI 700,000 and exemptions zero it gets a 59,400 excess, takes the lesser 50,000, and applies parameter path gov.irs.deductions.itemized.limitation.obbb.rate=0.05405405. Its observed float32 reduction is 2702.702392578125, and the final subtraction in itemized_taxable_income_deductions.py returns 47297.296875. PE never consumes the completed lawful section-68 base.

issue: https://github.com/PolicyEngine/policyengine-us/issues/9171. 26 USC 68(a) requires the exact rational 2/37 reduction. This case makes the lesser-of base exactly 10,000,000, so the lawful reduction is 20,000,000/37 = 540540.540540... and the lawful final is 350,000,000/37 = 9459459.459459... (the generator's float left value is 9459459.45945946). Pinned parameter path gov.irs.deductions.itemized.limitation.obbb.rate stores the truncated decimal 0.05405405. PE's observed float32 reduction is 540540.5, and its float32 final subtraction rounds to 9459460.0. This is a source parameter truncation amplified by the declared engine representation, not a tolerance-only residual; the one-cent suite tolerance remains unchanged.
